title: LIAR GAME

opinions.point: Community reaction was overwhelmingly enthusiastic, especially about the clever mind games and strategic writing.
Many praised the character development, particularly Nao becoming more capable while retaining her kindness.
Viewers enjoyed the performances and distinctive vocal delivery.
Several commenters criticized the limited animation budget and generally weak visual quality.
Some found the mechanics difficult to follow and felt the early portions moved too slowly, despite enjoying the overall experience.
The season ending generated strong excitement for the announced continuation.

notes: The title and body identify Liar Game episode 26, with no conflicting season marker. Reddit exposed the discussion and visible comments, but did not expose reliable score or comment-count metadata in the retrieved page, so those fields remain 0 rather than being guessed. Comment text was paraphrased
